description: AletheiaDB Performance Targets - Single source of truth for performance goals

targets.rationale: Zero temporal overhead for non-temporal queries
Direct anchor lookup with minimal overhead
Delta application for mid-range historical queries
Acceptable for compliance and audit queries

End-to-end tool latency through the shipped aletheia-mcp stdio server keeps LLM tool calls interactive (Issue #3361). Measured by the mcp_round_trip bench under an Async durability profile; gated per-scenario, hard-failed in the nightly lane.

targets.metric: MCP transport overhead (round-trip minus in-process direct call)
targets.rationale: JSON-RPC serialization + stdio + process-boundary cost above the direct API floor for single-entity reads (Issue #3361). Independently checkable per scenario via the overhead sub-metric.
